The animal with distinctive black and white stripes is the zebra.

Regarding the cloud computing-related security issues in the text, the primary vulnerability is the lack of proper network access controls on the public cloud data storage. Specifically, the e-commerce platform failed to configure restrictions on its storage buckets, leading to unrestricted access. This misconfiguration allowed unauthorized entities to access the data, resulting in data leaks. This highlights a critical failure in identity and access management (IAM) and network security policies, where storage resources were exposed to the public internet or unauthorized users without adequate authentication or authorization mechanisms.
